text:
Asha: Walked in at 9:02 and someone had left a tiny paper bell on the side desk. Immediate lore potential. :bell:
Ben: tiny bells are obviously a civic symbol now. We need a constitution. :scroll:
Doorman Dan: The Bell is ancient. I accept custodianship, pending granola barter. Rule 1: Ring only for important things (new Doorkeeper, pizza, unsolvable merge conflict).
Maya: can we have a tiny ceremony when the bell is rung? Like three solemn claps + a haiku. :heart:
Asha: love the haiku. Also can we get a sticker: "I answered the bell"? :laughing:
Ben: petition to rename the side door to "The Minute Porch" because everything takes five minutes longer there.
Doorman Dan: Minute Porch is approved by me, the appointed Doorkeeper. Also adding clause: any ringing at 11pm requires donuts.
Maya: ops-bot can you set up a 24h poll: Sticker / Mural / Nothing? low effort.
ops-bot: Poll created: "Tiny Bell: Sticker / Mural / Nothing". React to vote.
Asha: voted Sticker. :white_check_mark:
Ben: voted Mural. :artist_palette:
Doorman Dan: voted Sticker. :bell:
Maya: voted Sticker and haiku ready. 1) Dawn light on the latch 2) crumbs of last night's meeting 3) someone rings for pizza.
Asha: someone suggested bell training. We should have a 2-minute onboarding card: how to ring, how to bow, and granola token rules.
Ben: adding ‘bowing’ is non-negotiable. It increases ceremony metrics.
Doorman Dan: I will handcraft a tiny oath: "I will guard crumbs and answer the bell with dignity." Signing it with a Sharpie.
Maya: can we get ops-bot to ping #random-photos for a bell pic?
ops-bot: Posted image to #random-photos: https://files.redwood/tiny_bell.jpg. Reminder scheduled: "Tiny Bell poll closes in 24h". :bell:
